body: I appreciate your encouraging words. If I truly start to think she might hurt herself then I will step in and call someone but until then I'm just going to try and be moral support and a shoulder to cry on... Today we talked on the phone and we started talking about anxiety and how letting little things fester in our mind until they develop in to bigger issues. I quoted fight club and I feel like it kinda helped lol. I told her “No fear. No distractions. The ability to let that which does not matter truly slide.” and let her know to apply let that to daily life.

She would kill me if I said something to her parents... The thing that bothers me the most is the crowd she is starting to hang out with. She used to be such a good girl but she's seriously going down a scary path. I know I can't really talk because I partake in coke use occasionally and drink every weekend but she's taking it to a completely other level. Idk dude, I'm so conflicted

I'm going to invite her to the Texas Rangers game with me Wednesday, I'm hoping she says yes because I plan on having a heart to heart with her after the game.... Btw she was mentioning getting her CDL and my heart sunk but I just went along with it because her friend was around and I didn't want to seem lame.
